evidence_against: Bars 90-116 are a 27-bar two-sided range with dense overlap; the whole window can be read as large trading ranges (base 1512.91-1974.46, then 2357.18-2680) with bar 87-89 as one oversized leg rather than a sustained trend.
Bar 120 does not close at its high (74.39 upper tail) and clears the prior high 2771 by only 4.61, a margin well inside the 100+ point bars seen in this window.
The three prior pushes above 2600 all failed with closes back near mid-range (bar 110 H2680/C2514.72, bar 113 H2609.02/C2514.07, bar 118 H2700/C2632.98), showing sellers above 2600.
Bar 89's 255.70 upper tail right after bar 87's vertical rise is consistent with a buy climax; a climax followed by 27 bars of overlap often ends the trend leg instead of continuing it.
No bar before the final one closed above 2700, so acceptance above the range top is not yet demonstrated.
evidence_for: Progression of higher lows since the window low: 1368.42 (bar 13), 1512.91 (bar 33), 1821.49 (bar 71), 2357.18 (bar 101); highs also rise (1974.46 bar 64, 2771 bar 89, 2850 bar 120).
Bar 87's spike (335.65 body, close 41.64 below its high) breaks out of the 73-bar base with the strongest momentum bar in the window, and bars 88-89 extend it to 2771.
The 27-bar consolidation never retraces into the pre-spike area: its low 2357.18 (bar 101) is 451.55 above bar 87's low 1905.63, so higher prices are being held.

Bars 117-120 are four consecutive up-closing bars, and the last close 2775.61 sits above the range high 2700 and above the prior spike high 2771, which is an upside breakout attempt rather than a test of the range low.
Bar 120 closes in the upper 64% of its 208.3 range, so the latest Always-In direction is long on the current bars.

structures.description: Opening bear selloff from the window high 2139.34 (bar 1) to 1368.42 (bar 13 low): 13 bars of mostly lower closes with ranges expanding to 230.85 on bar 13, whose 200.13 lower tail shows sellers giving up the low; immediately reversed by the large bull bar 14.

Long base/consolidation after the selloff, 1512.91 (bar 33 low) to 1974.46 (bar 64 high). Bars 14-38 chop roughly 1550-1845; bars 39-86 drift up with higher lows and repeated tests of 1900-1975; heavy overlap throughout, typical range behavior.

Three-bar bull spike out of the base. Bar 87 (O1916.51 H2293.8 L1905.63 C2252.16) is a 335.65-body bull trend bar closing 41.64 below its high; bar 88 closes 2326.32; bar 89 spikes to 2771 and closes 2515.30, leaving a 255.70 upper tail.

27-bar two-sided range following the spike, 2357.18 (bar 101 low) to 2680 (bar 110 high). Dense overlap; the bulk of bars trade 2386-2557 and each upside probe closes back inside (bar 110 H2680/C2514.72, bar 113 H2609.02/C2514.07, bar 118 H2700/C2632.98).

Current four-bar up leg and upside breakout attempt above the 27-bar range: closes 2612.02, 2632.98, 2642.90 and 2775.61 from bar 117's 2446.22 open. Bar 120 (O2642.9 H2850 L2641.7 C2775.61) closes above the range high 2700 and 4.61 above the window's prior high 2771, but 74.39 below its own high, so acceptance is not yet shown.

transition_conditions: Bull continuation: a close above 2850, or a second consecutive close above 2771 with the bar closing in its upper third, would confirm acceptance above the range and support trend continuation.

Failed breakout: a close back below 2700, and especially below 2680 (bar 110 high), re-entering the 2357.18-2680 range, would mark bar 120's push as a failed breakout, particularly if the bar closes near its low.
Range continuation: continued overlap with highs capped near 2771-2850 and no new closing high would keep the phase as range and shift the regime read toward trading-range.

Trend damage: a close below 2436.87 (bar 117 low) negates the four-bar leg; a close below 2357.18 (bar 101 low) ends the post-spike higher-low sequence and turns the read to transition-unclear or trading-range.
Deep failure: acceptance below 2111 (bar 88 low) would invalidate the spike structure and return the pre-spike base to relevance.

evidence_against: The spike bar 1789977600000 closed 2723.15, 126.85 points (about 66% of its 191.94 range) below its 2850 high, showing sellers at the high and possible climactic buying.
The two decision bars are bear bars closing near their lows (2738.87, 2724.95), and 2804.59 is a lower high versus 2850; there is no sustained acceptance at the highs after the spike.

For the first 114 bars everything stayed below 2700 and price repeatedly rejected highs (2527.18 to 2450.96; 2609.02 to 2514.07; 2643.52 to 2569.80), so a four-bar push to 2850 can still be an overshoot of a broad trading range.
Trading has been heavily overlapping for most of the window (five tight bars 2448.81-2461.01; ten bars 2568.16-2674.67), which weakens the case that a sustained trend has replaced the range.
evidence_for: Higher highs across the window (2537.57, 2680, 2700, 2850) with higher lows after 2358.62 (2381, 2413.82, 2469.24, 2570, 2646.02, 2716.01) is the classic bull-trend swing sequence.
Four consecutive closes above the prior 2680/2700 range top (2723.15, 2754.31, 2760.51, 2775.61) show acceptance above the range rather than a one-bar poke, and 2804.59 extended the follow-through.

The breakout leg contains large trend bars with closes near their highs (2578.60, 2636.28, 2723.15) and expanding ranges (191.94 on 1789977600000), the shape of a spike rather than a leg inside a range.
Prior pullbacks within the window were bought: 2442.47, 2464.27, 2568.16 and 2646.02 lows all held above the window low and were followed by new highs.

structures.description: Broad two-sided rotation occupying most of the window: repeated swings between the 2357.18/2358.62 lows and the 2680-2700 highs, with overlapping bars, doji clusters and deep pullbacks (2506.79 back to 2442.47; 2643.52 back to 2569.80). The first 114 bars of the window all traded below 2700.

Bull breakout leg out of the 2568-2645 base: 1789732800000 closed 2578.60 and 1789747200000 closed 2636.28, then 1789977600000 spiked from open 2658.81 to high 2850 and closed 2723.15, clearing the 2680/2700 range top. Follow-through bars closed 2754.31, 2760.51 and 2775.61 with a 2804.59 high.

Two-bar bear response at the top of the spike: new high 2850 on 1789977600000 (126.85 upper tail), a lower follow-through high 2804.59 on 1790020800000, then bear bars 1790035200000 (close 2738.87) and 1790049600000 (close 2724.95, low 2716.01) closing in the lower part of their ranges. Consistent with a first pullback in the new leg and equally consistent with a range overshoot; no prior significant low has been broken.

transition_conditions: Bull continuation: a bull bar closing above 2776.18 or above 2804.59, or a pullback that holds above 2700 and reverses up with a bull bar closing near its high, would confirm breakout acceptance and support a bull-trend/channel read.

Bearish resolution: a close back below 2700, or a two-legged pullback breaking the 2646.02 spike base and the 2643.52 area where the breakout started, would mark the 2850 push as a range overshoot and return the classification to trading-range.
Ambiguity: continued overlapping bars contained inside 2716.01-2804.59 with no new high and no break of 2646.02 would leave the read transition-unclear.
